triggerCases.prompt: 根据《思考，快与慢》这个书名做一条完整竖屏图书种草视频，这周先发成片，下周我要换封面和第三张图，再改两句字幕重发。
triggerCases.reason: A natural title-first request implies the editable dual delivery only through planned later cover, visual, and caption changes.

triggerCases.prompt: 我只给你这本书的商品页和封面图，做一条视频号挂车片；以后每周换封面复用这套内容。
triggerCases.reason: Product-page identity plus recurring cover replacement implies source checking and reusable editable delivery without naming an editor.

triggerCases.prompt: 《纳瓦尔宝典》的口播稿已经定稿，不要改字；豆包一次合成拿时间戳，做可编辑时间线并导出质检通过的MP4。
triggerCases.reason: Approved script, provider timing, editable assembly, and final QA.

triggerCases.prompt: 给这六本书批量做书单号视频，每本都要来源记录、可二改工程、独立字幕轨和成片，不接受只交模板或压平视频。
triggerCases.reason: Batch production with source evidence and non-flattened delivery.

triggerCases.prompt: 上次《蛤蟆先生去看心理医生》只给了扁平MP4，请按原素材补成非空OpenChatCut工程，核对轨道后重新导出。
triggerCases.reason: Repair of an existing book video to restore editable delivery.

triggerCases.prompt: 诊断这个卖书视频：字幕比豆包旁白慢半秒，编辑器里又少了两张图；修好工程、复核时间戳并重出MP4。
triggerCases.reason: Book-video diagnosis spanning timestamps, assets, editor, and MP4.

triggerCases.prompt: 我准备在视频号挂《认知觉醒》，先核对版本和书中观点再做成竖屏视频；过几天我还要改开头和字幕再发一版。
triggerCases.reason: A natural sales-video request with planned later copy edits implicitly requires both deliverables.

triggerCases.prompt: 现有OpenChatCut书单工程第三段换图，重新导出MP4，并保持字幕和旁白时间戳一致。
triggerCases.reason: Existing OpenChatCut book project repair and verified rerender.

triggerCases.prompt: 《底层逻辑》的书名、封面和旁白已经确认，只替换正文画面，然后把可编辑工程和发布版MP4都重新验收。
triggerCases.reason: Regeneration from approved controls with editor and media QA.

triggerCases.prompt: 把《百年孤独》这条可编辑书单视频修到字幕同步、画面匹配，再覆盖Cloudflare上的版本。
triggerCases.reason: Repair, QA, and explicit publication of an existing book video.

triggerCases.prompt: 把《原则》做成60秒竖屏卖书视频，我只收可以直接发布的成片，中间素材和剪辑工程不用交。
triggerCases.reason: Explicit MP4-only and no-editor boundary.

triggerCases.prompt: 用ChatCut给《小狗钱钱》做一条电影感种草片，交可编辑工程和MP4；这次明确不需要微信读书取证、豆包时间戳或发布验收。
triggerCases.reason: Explicit generic ChatCut dual delivery opts out of this Skill's evidence, timestamp, and release contract.

triggerCases.prompt: 先写《刻意练习》的60秒带货口播稿，今天不要做视频。
triggerCases.reason: No video deliverable is requested.

triggerCases.prompt: 把《活着》做成60秒竖屏种草视频，用微信读书核对内容并用豆包时间戳对字幕；我只收可发布MP4，不要任何剪辑工程。
triggerCases.reason: Even strong research and timestamp signals cannot override an explicit MP4-only/no-project boundary.

triggerCases.prompt: 写一篇公众号书评，分析《百年孤独》的叙事结构。
triggerCases.reason: Article output with no video.

triggerCases.prompt: 把这篇《认知觉醒》读书笔记做成无真人解释动画，只讲元认知，不推荐书、不卖书，也不要剪辑工程。
triggerCases.reason: Concept-only explainer without recommendation, sales, or editable-book-video delivery.

triggerCases.prompt: 把这段作者访谈原片剪成卖书视频，删停顿、重排节奏、加字幕和BGM，最后交ChatCut工程和MP4。
triggerCases.reason: Speech-led existing-footage recutting belongs to the ChatCut talking-head workflow, not source-built book-video creation.

triggerCases.prompt: 给《三体》做完整竖屏卖书视频，核对书页内容并用豆包时间戳对字幕；明确用HyperFrames，交HTML和MP4，不要ChatCut或OpenChatCut工程。
triggerCases.reason: An explicit HyperFrames deliverable wins even when research and provider-timestamp signals overlap.

triggerCases.prompt: 这个已有的HyperFrames书单项目字幕错位，修复composition并批量重渲染。
triggerCases.reason: Existing project explicitly belongs to HyperFrames.

triggerCases.prompt: 把《原子习惯》的书单素材组成一个后续能改的剪辑工程，这次先不配音、不质检，也不导出成片。
triggerCases.reason: Editable-project-only work lacks the required verified MP4 dual delivery.

executionAssertions.assertion: New projects require both structured visual-source enums and persist them.
The rendered video, audio mix, timing inputs, case, and manifest match the current build-report hashes.
Research, claims, copy, captions, source policy, and manifest agree before generation.
The full narration, evidence boundary, and semantic storyboard use one stable output contract.
Paid generation requires a current receipt bound to content, storyboard, voice preview/report, and manifest semantics.
One-pass provider words cover all narration and captions with acoustic-safe holds.
The renderer consumes only the frozen manifest and provider-derived frame ranges.
A reopened non-flattened editor project maps every expected source component.
The editor adapter consumed a current deterministic original-component plan rather than model-invented timing or parameters.
Streams, decode, timing, audio, hashes, human review, and editor identity all pass.
Immediately before publication, every artifact still matches the hashes in the current release marker.
